rateLimits.note: "10 appels toutes les 10 secondes" on the authentication API (POST /oauth2/token).
"20 appels toutes les 10 minutes" on the authentication API.
"50 appels toutes les heures" on the authentication API.

provenance.notes: The figures are the authentication API's (dev.helloasso.com/docs/limitation-api): "token" is the provider's own access token request, guarded inside its operations (Config::guard()); the token is kept 30 minutes per provider instance, as HelloAsso asks. The page sets no figure for the other endpoints (organizations, forms, orders, items): unknown, and a 429 holds the calls. The general terms (helloasso.com/cgu) answered 403 on 2026-11-10 and the developer pages state no rights: commercial use, caching, storage, redistribution and attribution unknown.
